title: Family Paralegal
description:
A well established High Street law firm is seeking a Family Paralegal to join its Family team in Newbury. This Family Paralegal role offers exposure to a broad range of private family matters, supporting solicitors throughout the full case lifecycle. The Family Paralegal will gain hands-on experience across client care, legal drafting and case preparation. This Family Paralegal opportunity is suited to someone looking to build a long-term career within family law.

The Company?

The successful Family Paralegal will join a respected local law firm with an established Family team advising clients on a wide range of private family matters. The team provides a supportive working environment, ongoing mentoring and direct exposure to client work alongside experienced solicitors.

The Role

As the Family Paralegal you will support fee earners across a varied caseload of family matters.

The role will include:

Assisting with divorce, financial remedy and private children matters
Preparing legal documents, correspondence and court bundles
Conducting legal research and case preparation
Managing case files and maintaining accurate records
Liaising with clients, barristers, courts and third parties
Supporting domestic abuse and cohabitation matters
Assisting with general file administration and case progression
Monitoring deadlines and ensuring matters progress efficiently

The Family Paralegal?

You will have previous family law experience and a genuine interest in developing your career within family law.

The Family Paralegal must have:

Previous experience within a Family Law team
Strong drafting and communication skills
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities
Professional, empathetic and client focused approach
Strong administrative and case management skills
Good IT and case management system skills
Ability to work effectively within a team

In return ?

25,000 to 28,000 salary
Training and development opportunities
Exposure to a broad range of family law matters
Direct mentoring from experienced Family solicitors
Supportive and collaborative team environment
Long term career progression
Competitive benefits package

If you are a Family Paralegal considering your next career move, please contact Chris van Aurich at Brandon James on (phone number removed) for a confidential discussion.

title: Legal Secretary / Assistant - Family & Litigation
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
I am recruiting for a well established, leading Law firm in Slough who is looking for a secretary or paralegal with experience to support a friendly and fast paced Family & Litigation department. This role offers training and development, excellent benefits and competitive salary. This is an office based role, the position could be full or part time for the right person.

Responsibilities:
- Assist Solicitors in managing a diverse caseload of family law matters.
- Conduct thorough legal research and prepare relevant documentation for client cases.
- Coordinate and schedule client meetings, court appearances, and other appointments.
- Maintain accurate and organized case files and documents.
- Draft legal correspondence, petitions, and motions.
- Communicate with clients, opposing counsel, and court personnel professionally and effectively.
- Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits and assisting with courtroom logistics.
- Stay updated on changes in family law regulations and procedures.

Please apply asap, this is a fantastic opportunity to work for a progressive law firm.

title: Residential Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Property Paralegal

Location: Wokingham, Berkshire

Salary: Competitive + benefits

Type: Full-time, Permanent

A well-established Thames Valley law firm is looking for a Residential Property Paralegal to join its busy Wokingham team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous residential property experience as a Legal Assistant or Conveyancing Assistant who is now looking to develop their career further within conveyancing.

The Role

Supporting experienced residential property solicitors across a varied caseload, you will gain hands-on experience throughout the conveyancing process, including:
- Opening and progressing residential property files
- Preparing contract packs and completion documentation
- Drafting Certificates of Title
- Carrying out searches and submitting SDLT returns
- Preparing and submitting Land Registry applications
- Dealing with Land Registry requisitions
- Liaising with clients, agents, lenders and solicitors

About You
- Previous residential property experience as a Legal Assistant or Conveyancing Assistant is essential
- Ideally educated to degree level, preferably with a Law degree
- Good understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and client care skills
- Keen to develop a career within residential property

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary + benefits
- Supportive and friendly team
- Training and career development
- Wokingham town-centre location

If you have residential property experience and are looking for your next step towards becoming a Conveyancing Paralegal, please email your CV or call Gayle W

title: Paralegal - Real Estate
description:
Paralegal - Real Estate

When registering to this job board you will be redirected to the online application form. Please ensure that this is completed in full in order that your application can be reviewed.

Field Seymour Parkes is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Paralegal to join its highly regarded Real Estate team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a law graduate or aspiring legal professional to gain hands-on experience within a leading commercial law firm, working alongside experienced lawyers on a broad range of high-quality real estate matters. You will play an important role in supporting the team while developing your legal knowledge and practical skills in a supportive and collaborative environment.

The Role

Working under the supervision of qualified lawyers, you will assist with a variety of commercial property and real estate matters, providing both legal and administrative support to ensure transactions progress efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:

Opening new files and undertaking client due diligence and Know Your Client (KYC) procedures
Preparing correspondence, reports, legal documents and attendance notes
Conducting legal research and property-related searches
Managing and maintaining electronic documents, databases and records
Assisting with document reviews, proof-reading and document production
Supporting transaction management and completion processes
Liaising with clients, agents and other third parties
Assisting with billing, time recording and other administrative processes
Supporting business development activities and client events where required

About You

We are looking for someone who:

Has a degree (minimum 2:1 preferred)
Has a genuine interest in Real Estate and Commercial Property law
Possesses excellent organisational and communication skills
Has strong attention to detail and a proactive approach
Is confident managing competing priorities and meeting deadlines
Enjoys working collaboratively as part of a team
Demonstrates a commitment to delivering exceptional client service

Why Join Field Seymour Parkes?

Field Seymour Parkes is one of the Thames Valley's leading law firms, recognised for delivering exceptional legal advice to businesses, individuals and organisations.

In return, we offer:

Exposure to high-quality real estate work
Ongoing training and development
A supportive and collaborative culture
Opportunities for career progression
Competitive salary and benefits package
Modern offices in the heart of Reading

This is an excellent opportunity to begin or further your legal career with a respected and forward-thinking firm.

Apply today to join the Real Estate team at Field Seymour Parkes.
